back: Gradient = VI ÷ HE (same units). 1 in n: n = HE ÷ VI. Percentage = VI ÷ HE × 100.
The difference in height between two points, from contours or spot heights.
The horizontal ground distance between two points, from the map scale, in metres.
Smaller n = steeper: 1 in 5 (20%) is steeper than 1 in 50 (2%).
VE = horizontal scale denominator ÷ vertical scale denominator, e.g. 50 000 ÷ 5 000 = 10.
Draw a straight line of sight on the cross-section; any land above the line blocks the view.
Railways need gentle gradients (valleys, cols, cuttings); roads use hairpin bends on steep slopes.
Paper strip along the line, tick contour crossings with heights, transfer to axes, join with a smooth curve, label, give VE.
